data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'ephrai', meaning 'fruitful or free'. This name was given to a man in the Bible, Pharaoh's servant, Joseph, who was given the name 'Zaphenath-paneah' (Genesis 41:45), which translates to 'God speaks and he lives'. Frech can be seen as a symbol of God's freedom and provision. The name Frech carries the meaning “Free, Noble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Frech usually hope their child will grow to embody free, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
